title: Fallen Statue and Ravens
description: A cracked stone statue of a person lies on the ground with glowing blue eyes and green vines wrapped around its body. Two large black ravens fly above it with blue symbols painted on their wings while a stone figure stands nearby with one hand raised near a glowing golden crystal on a pedestal.
